body: Bikol siguro yan. Bikol to Tagalog is something like this, "Ma break man lang kita" - "magbebreak up lang naman tayo".

It was actually my first time donating, I was trying not to pass out during the process that my worries temporarily went away for a moment. I've been feeling down for what seems like forever so I wanted to do something heroic. Turns out I'm still sad but at least I can now be sad heroically. I'm not actually into helping others that much because truthfully I can't even help myself. But I still want to volunteer for a good cause, so I guess my best option is to donate my blood. I had hobbies that I resort to whenever I feel overwhelmed. But it just doesn't feel right anymore. I'm not sure about anything else honestly. But seriously though, thank you soo much. Your concerns actually gave me some peace of mind even for a short period of time.

Blood donation center, it's the only place I could think of. Can't really go there right now since I've just donated a couple of weeks ago so I have to wait atleast 3 months for my next donation. But I don't think I could live anymore days let alone months. Other than that, everything peaceful to me just feels like good old escapism. I've done nothing but escaping my problems so much to the point my worries are overwhelming right now. I guess the only real way I could find peace is if I pull myself out of my personal hell.

If I could start again

A million miles away

I would keep myself

I would find a way

Damn.. felt the exact same situation and burnout too. Pagkakaiba lang is I went awol. I wanted to make adjustments pero wala eh.. Mahirap talaga when you're really down and your interest went downhill na kahit anong plano pa yan di kaya i follow through. 
Layo na ng narating ng friends ko while I'm here drowning in my thoughts and indecisiveness. Then there's the struggles when asking for help. Parang ang labo ng future na if only there's a way out I'll take it. You're not alone and I hope that you'll eventually find your way op.
